articles.headline: India's Voltas names Noel Tata as chairman emeritus
articles.brief: Voltas has announced the appointment of Noel Tata as its chairman emeritus, honoring his extensive contributions and leadership legacy within the corporate sector.

articles.headline: Britannia CEO plays down Reliance pricing threat
articles.brief: Britannia Industries CEO has minimized the competitive pricing threat posed by Reliance in the Indian biscuit market, expressing confidence in the company's strong brand equity and market positioning.

articles.headline: ONGC hopes to operate Venezuelan oil projects
articles.brief: India's ONGC expects to secure operational rights for two key Venezuelan oil projects within the next six months, aiming to bolster the country's energy security and overseas asset portfolio.

articles.headline: Indian stocks post best week in six years
articles.brief: Bucking the broader global tech rout, Indian equities surged significantly to post their best weekly performance in six years, driven by strong buying momentum and positive economic indicators.

articles.headline: TSMC considers manufacturing advanced memory chips
articles.brief: According to industry reports, semiconductor giant TSMC is actively considering expanding its manufacturing operations to include advanced memory chips to meet rising artificial intelligence demands.

articles.headline: Alphabet acquires stake in Qualcomm for data centers
articles.brief: Alphabet has invested $548 million to acquire a stake in its partner Qualcomm, signaling a major strategic push to enhance data center infrastructure and advanced hardware capabilities.

articles.headline: Trump replaces chief of staff after midterm defeat
articles.brief: Following the Republican Party's midterm election losses, Donald Trump has replaced Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller as his new chief of staff, shaking up his inner circle.

articles.headline: US sanctions Canadian companies over Iran transactions
articles.brief: The United States has imposed strict economic sanctions on eight Canadian entities, alleging they played a crucial role in enabling international financial transactions involving Iran.

articles.headline: Saudi Arabia extends $3 billion financial lifeline to Pakistan
articles.brief: Saudi Arabia has rolled over a $3 billion financial support package to Pakistan, providing Islamabad vital relief from external debt pressures amid growing strategic defense cooperation.

articles.headline: Delhi Police files FIR over child abuse material online
articles.brief: Acting on National Human Rights Commission directions, Delhi Police's Special Cell registered an FIR regarding the alleged circulation of child sexual abuse material on Meta platforms.

articles.headline: Finance Ministry urges ministries to prioritize capital expenditure
articles.brief: The Union finance ministry has instructed central departments to keep their capital expenditure engines running to sustain productive investment and hedge against mounting external risks.

articles.headline: Bharti Airtel reclaims No. 2 spot as valuable company
articles.brief: Bharti Airtel has successfully reclaimed the number two spot among India's most valuable companies, overtaking major competitors following recent market shifts.

articles.headline: CBI books Future Retail and Kishore Biyani in fraud case
articles.brief: The Central Bureau of Investigation has booked Kishore Biyani and Future Retail in connection with an alleged bank fraud amounting to ₹904 crores.

articles.headline: CBSE announces Class 10 and 12 board exam dates
articles.brief: The Central Board of Secondary Education has officially released the subject-wise date sheets and timetables for the upcoming Class 10 and 12 board examinations beginning next year.

articles.headline: Supreme Court rules on Himachal Pradesh power arrears
articles.brief: The Supreme Court has delivered a verdict favoring Himachal Pradesh in a decades-old dispute regarding its 7.19% share of power generation arrears from the BBMB projects.
